description: Skull-strip a head MRI with mindgrab, the brainchop brain-extraction model from the lightNIIng project, through the brainchop command-line interface (Python + tinygrad, runs on CPU or Apple GPU in a few seconds). Writes the brain-only image and a binary brain mask, both on the input grid.

t1.description: Full-head MRI (T1-weighted preferred; mindgrab is trained across contrasts).

border.description: Grow the brain mask by this many mm (0 keeps the model's mask).

brain.description: Input image with everything outside the brain zeroed.

brain_mask.description: Binary brain mask on the input grid.

block.label: Brain extraction (mindgrab)
block.description: Skull-strip with the brainchop mindgrab model.

requirements: brainchop CLI 0.2 or newer (pip install brainchop; on PATH or via BRAINCHOP)
neuroflow/launch.description: Runs brainchop <t1> --skull-strip --mask brain_mask.nii.gz --border <border> --no-optimize -o brain.nii.gz through the shared native CLI adapter.

probe.advice: Install or upgrade the brainchop CLI (pip install -U brainchop); this release has no --skull-strip mode.

useWhen: Skull-strip a full-head MRI locally in seconds, getting the brain image and a binary mask on the input grid.
A next step needs a brain-only image, e.g. affine registration to a brain-only template.

avoidWhen.when: You want SynthStrip or BET, or the brainchop CLI is not installed but the Neurodesk Webapps suite is.

preconditions: brainchop CLI 0.2 or newer with --skull-strip (pip install brainchop), on PATH or via BRAINCHOP.
t1 is a full-head NIfTI volume.
effects: Writes brain.nii.gz and brain_mask.nii.gz to the output directory, both on the input grid.
border above 0 grows the mask by that many mm.

duration.basis: Measured over 9 gallery runs on an Apple-silicon Mac: median 3.8 s for a 1 mm T1; the slowest took 10.4 s.

examples.title: Keep a 2 mm margin around the brain

failures.remedy: pip install brainchop, or set BRAINCHOP to its path.

match.contains: does not look like a usable brainchop

failures.meaning: The brainchop found is too old: it has no --skull-strip mode.
failures.remedy: pip install -U brainchop, or point BRAINCHOP at a newer install.
Read the step log, and check that t1 is a readable NIfTI with neuroflow_inspect.
